subscriptions.pastDueWarning: The last payment failed. Your access continues while we retry — please update your payment method in the billing portal.

subscriptions.checkoutSuccessDescription: Your Employer panel plan is being activated.

teams.title: Teams Management
teams.noTeams: No teams found. Create a new team to get started.

wellbeingIndex.title: Activity Index
wellbeingIndex.description: Track how active your organisation is over time.

calculation.title: How it is calculated
calculation.body: Every completed activity gives an employee 1 point. Points are summed per month and accumulated over the membership year that starts when the employee joins.

monthlyPoints.title: Monthly points
monthlyPoints.body: Total activity points per month across all active teams and employees.

yearlyTotal.title: Yearly total
yearlyTotal.body: Accumulated points per employee since they joined.

paymentBanner.text: All payments made in the preview are in test mode.

activitySummary.title: Activity summary
activitySummary.description: Aggregated overview of your organization's activity. Individual exercise details are never shown.
activitySummary.errorBody: Activity reports are available to the organization owner. Ask your administrator for access.

engagement.title: Engagement & community
engagement.description: Aggregated view of community participation. Post and comment content is never shown.
engagement.errorBody: Engagement reports are available to the organization owner. Ask your administrator for access.

activityIndexReport.title: Activity Index
activityIndexReport.description: The Activity Index is built from performed activities: each completed activity gives one point, summed per month and over the year.
activityIndexReport.errorBody: Only organization managers can view aggregated reports.
activityIndexReport.calculationBody: Every activity an employee completes is worth 1 point. Points are summed monthly and accumulated over the year from the moment the employee joined. The index per employee is the organization's total points divided by the number of employees.

roi.title: Administration & ROI
roi.description: Upload your own sick leave data and compare it with Vointy activity data to see the return on investment.
roi.errorBody: Only organization managers can view aggregated ROI reports.
roi.noData: No sick leave data uploaded yet.
roi.chartTitle: Sick leave days vs. Activity Index

upload.title: Upload sick leave data
upload.help: Upload a CSV file with one row per month (and optionally per team). Recognised columns: month, sick_days, team, absent_employees, headcount. Existing months are updated.
upload.privacyNote: Upload aggregated figures only — do not include names or personal health details.
upload.noRows: No valid rows found. Check that the file has month and sick_days columns.
upload.noOrg: Your account is not linked to an organization.

predictive.title: Predictive analytics
predictive.description: Forecast of the activity index and early warnings about employees and teams whose activity is dropping.
predictive.errorBody: Only organization managers can view predictive reports.
predictive.teamRiskTitle: Teams at risk of dropping off
predictive.noRisk: No employees at risk right now.
predictive.method1: The forecast is a linear trend fitted to the last 12 months of the activity index (points per employee).
predictive.method2: Risk level combines days since the last activity, the change between the last 30 days and the previous 30 days, and the current activity level.
predictive.method3: Projected sick days extrapolate the change between the last two 12-month periods; savings use your cost per sick day.

qualityIndex.title: Activity Index (quality, 0–100)
qualityIndex.description: Company average from the last 30 days: consistency, variety, community and perceived wellbeing. Aggregated only — no individual employee data.
